Reset failed-attempt counter

fixtures.title: Work email not syncing on phone, fixed on call

output.issue_description: The caller's work email was not syncing on her Android phone. New messages only appeared when she opened the email app on her laptop.
steps_taken: Asked the caller to toggle Sync off and on again in the mail app settings.
Asked the caller to check that background data was allowed for the mail app.
output.resolution_outcome: The issue was resolved by turning on background data for the mail app.
output.call_summary: Sophie Bakker called about her work email not syncing on her Android phone. The agent helped her troubleshoot the issue by checking background data settings, which was resolved.
